bio: Focusing on the cuisine of northeastern Thailand, this cheery operation has quickly become one of Vancouver's favorites for casual Thai. The sizable menu makes the typical concessions to crowd-pleasing mainstays like pad Thai and pad see ew, which are prepared diligently, but it's the regional specialties on offer that will leave the strongest impression. Think boat noodles, featuring funky, aromatic beef broth loaded with bouncy meatballs and tripe, or crunchy, succulent grilled pork jowl with toasted rice and a punchy nam jaew dipping sauce. Although there are options for all tastes, diners seeking to break a sweat are not likely to be disappointed when requesting spice....
